title: How to Clone a Voice and Generate Speech with Codex MCP and Medux
description: This tutorial shows how to provide a reference voice file and a text file, then let Codex call Medux through MCP to upload the audio, create a voice clone, synthesize speech, and save the generated WAV file locally.
